newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - June 19.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - June 19.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Justice Ministry revises law to increase penalties against convicted criminals
-- Taiwan to form regional alliance with 13 Central American and Caribbean diplomatic allies
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Nationalist, Democratic Progressive parties reach initial consensus on phase-out of Taiwan provincial government
LIBERTY TIMES - Economics ministry to help Taiwan manufacturers if wrongly accused abroad in trade secret cases
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Central banks says no change in monetary policy
-- China plans to help Taiwan investors resolve loan acquisition problem
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Central bank not to intervene in stock market rallies
-- Taiwan lists restrictions on investments in Hong Kong and Macau after July 1 HK handover
